notes.title: Early Access release is here!
notes.content:
The game is finally out in Early Access. The early access version includes
- 45+ cards
- 20+ enemies
- 2 Worlds, each with 2 possible bosses
- Random Events
- The Archive: Collect information on cards, enemies and more


Now is the time to collect feedback, hear constructive (or not) criticism, fix bugs, and just see what's in store for the future of Calamity Sanctuary. If you want to join the discussion, then please join the official Discord channel : https://discord.gg/mnnC55hE

Good luck finding the Calamity Sanctuary!

notes.title: Demo is now available
notes.content:
The demo for Calamity Sanctuary is now available! It includes
[list]
[*] Almost [b]40 [/b]cards
[*] More than [b]15 [/b]Daemons
[*] The initial planet, our lovely Earth
[*] A (tiny) peak into the world of Calamity Sanctuary
[/list]
However, it also includes things like
[list]
[*] Missing or placeholder assets
[*] Bugs!
[*] Confusing UI
[*] [b]And More![/b]
[/list]
The demo does not represent the final quality of the game, but after being basically the only playtester for this game, it was time to put Calamity Sanctuary into the hands of the people. So please give the demo a go, and tell me your thoughts about the game.

I will update the demo with any bug fixes or quality of life improvements, but all content updates will only be available in the full game when it releases

Have fun!
